summary: Fix D-056 substrate: ci/checks/agent-instruction-runtime-dormant.sh (FF-COMP-6) was RED on a clean dev checkout (dev@b50308be) — its src/http detector (grep -rlE) is comment-unaware, and two pure documentation comments in src/http/agents.ts (byte-identical to origin/dev) tripped it, masking npm run fitness's honest signal on every branch. The gate is right in spirit; only its pattern was wrong. FIX (rev 2, after judge R1): strip_comment_substrings() — a string-aware per-character POSIX-awk scanner that strips comment SUBSTRINGS (inline + multi-line /* */ spans; // tails unless inside a string literal; full-line # only) while preserving string literals (dquote/squote/backtick-template, escape-aware) — then re-applies the unchanged pattern (file_has_code_level_agent_instruction_hit()). R1 (judge, blocking, fixed): the first revision stripped whole physical lines by leading comment opener, so `/* note */ <real code hit>` on one line was invisible (a NEW false negative, judge live-reproduced). Reworked to substring stripping; R1 shapes pinned as 8 new permanent --self-test probes (10 total) and re-proven RED as live mutations (4, incl. the judge's exact shape). Diff against BASE_REF remains 100% pure insertion (0 lines removed/modified; the rework replaces only this task's own prior insertion) — verified by manual diff and by ci/checks/auto-sanction-additive.sh --verify (A-1..A-4 PASS).
